title: Persona and artifact rows say whether they are current or test or retired and a missing win rate is null
hosted_verification_note: No VM or SSH access performed by worker per hard task rules; functional verification recorded from local contract and recorded-shape tests; hosted verification is owned by the downstream operator acceptance task.

implementation: services/control-plane/bff/personas/routes/collection.py: GET /bff/personas rows carry listScope while keeping the default row set, order, and paging unchanged.
ac1_persona_list_scope.rule: 'test' comes from classify_persona_data_scope(record) == 'test', strategy_family == 'dev_paper_baseline', or provisioning_idempotency_key starting with RELEASE_CASE_KEY_PREFIX ('dev-paper-release-'), and never from name.

implementation: services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py: added _project_recorded_success_rate(*candidates) returning None when no value was recorded or when the recorded value is the filled-in 0.0.

Updated all four persona projections (_project_persona_dto, _persona_create_response, _project_persona_league_row, patch_persona) so successRate and league row success_rate agree and no win rate is computed.
Updated _persona_provisioning_metadata and patch_persona to write success_rate into metadata only when the caller explicitly sent successRate or success_rate.

services/control-plane/bff/ports/research_knowledge_source.py: kept get_strategy_labels returning its exact {strategy_id: {'title': title, 'name': title}} shape; added get_strategy_persona_bindings sharing the single request-cached GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=persona_binding read.

services/control-plane/bff/research/routes/artifacts.py: _annotate_artifact_payload resolves the persona directory once per page and joins registry strategy_id -> bound persona_ids -> persona listScope to set list_scope ('current' | 'test' | 'retired' | 'unbound' for registry rows; 'research' for research_run_output rows).

services/control-plane/bff/research/routes/artifacts.py: when the persona directory cannot be read, every returned row receives list_scope='unknown', meta.surfaces.persona_directory.status='unavailable' (and meta.persona_directory_status='unavailable'), and no row is dropped.

ac5_recorded_shapes_and_first_page_byte_.first_page_bytes_limit: test_artifact_catalog_registry first_page_bytes < 16384 holds with list_scope on all 20 rows in data and items.

contract_updates: services/control-plane/bff/BFF_API_CONTRACT.md line 570: documented list_scope on /bff/artifacts and /bff/artifacts/{artifact_id} rows and meta.surfaces.persona_directory.status='unavailable' degradation.
services/control-plane/bff/BFF_API_CONTRACT.md line 1114: documented listScope on GET /bff/personas rows and null successRate / success_rate when unrecorded or 0.0.

changed_test_assertions.change: Added 'list_scope' to CATALOG_ROW_KEYS and wired port.list_personas = lambda: [] in seeded_catalog_env.
changed_test_assertions.justification: Every /bff/artifacts row now carries 'list_scope' by contract (AC 3), and CATALOG_ROW_KEYS asserts exact key-set equality on catalog rows while keeping the < 16384 byte first-page assertion intact.

runtime_budget.per_request_read_cost: GET /bff/personas adds zero owner reads (pure in-memory classification). GET /bff/artifacts performs 1 bounded persona directory read per page via cached_owner_call/shared_persona_directory_list and reuses the single request-cached GET /api/registry/strategy-specs?view=persona_binding read already performed for strategy display names.
